sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Halloween: Enemy of My Enemy is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Well, fuck me sideways. Now it all makes sense. TerraGroup deliberately unleashed this infection AGAIN. The whole of Tarkov's their bloody testing ground, same as before. And that vaccine they palmed off on me? Part of the scheme. That's what they used to kick off the next stage. Those c***s were watching the whole bloody thing: how fast the quarantine went up, how people fought back, whether anyone could cook up a cure. We're all just lab rats in their reports. So, for the record, I'm not the only one to blame here. They slipped me the shit, and I had no idea what was in it. Looks like it's time to stop butting heads with Therapist, at least for a bit, and give the people playing games with us a bloody nose instead. Take these documents to her. Let her have a read."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Hand over the clues to Therapist
